name: Monster Lord: Reincarnated
source:
Trapped in an endless cycle of self-destruction, our protagonist finds himself pulled away from the comfort of his life. By dying!

This is the story of a NEET, and self-proclaimed Pro gamer who dies in a fit of rage after losing a league match. He then finds himself forming a contract with a stranger in a sea of darkness. To survive, he will have to reincarnate in a strange world, filled with monster cuties! Will he do the stranger bidding? Will he bang everything that moves? Hell yeah! 

[From [url=https://goblin-enjoyer.itch.io/monster-lord-reincarnated]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们的主角陷入了无休止的自我毁灭的循环中，发现自己远离了舒适的生活。通过死亡！

这是一个自称职业玩家的尼特族在联赛输掉后暴怒而死的故事。然后他发现自己在黑暗的海洋中与一个陌生人签订了契约。为了生存，他必须转生到一个充满怪物可爱的陌生世界！他会听从陌生人的命令吗？他会敲打所有会动的东西吗？是啊！

[来自[url=https://goblin-enjoyer.itch.io/monster-lord-reincarnated]Itch.io[/url]]
